SIFU Kidnapped! Adventure in the Women's Kingdom

name: Sifu Kidnapped!: Adventure in the Women's Kingdom
storyline:
A modern corporate slave wakes up to find himself reincarnated as the 100th incarnation of Golden Cicada! Stumbling into the all-female Western Liang Kingdom, he must unravel the earth-shaking conspiracy behind the polluted Mother-Son River while navigating deep emotional bonds with 7 goddess-level characters of distinct personalities—from the powerful and glamorous queen to the vengeance-driven Scorpion Demon, the innocent and impulsive monkey apprentice, the arrogant and willful Dragon Princess, the loyal and calm Sand Guardian, the fox demon who wields dream-invasion magic, and the cold yet compassionate Immortal.

This is the ultimate choice between Buddhist compassion and mortal desire! Assume the role of the protagonist Chen Yi in first-person perspective, making crucial decisions in demon-subduing puzzles and sweet interactions. Every conversation shapes favorability, and every choice alters the fate of the Three Realms. Will you honor the bet between Tathagata Buddha and the Demon King, sever earthly ties, and attain Buddhahood? Or follow your heart and spend a lifetime with your beloved?

Many distinct endings await—from achieving Buddhahood in the West to staying in the Women's Kingdom, from becoming a dragon palace son-in-law to wandering the world. Every step writes your unique time-travel adventure!
